SourceKind.description: A kind of source the user can add.

oneOf.description: A picture: a file or a built-in sample (protocol 1.34, ADR-0075).
A local media file (protocol TBD, ADR-0108).
A browser page from the helper process (protocol TBD, ADR-0109).
A text drawn by the server's text renderer (protocol 1.75, ADR-0129).
The pictures of one folder shown one after another (protocol 1.102, ADR-0171).

kind.description: The kind whose capture targets to list.

output_schema.description: Parameters of a method that takes none. Unknown fields are ignored.
output_schema.title: Empty

input_schema.description: Parameters of a method that takes none. Unknown fields are ignored.
input_schema.title: Empty

Canvas.description: The canvas's size and frame rate.

oneOf.description: WAV (`.wav`): the mix as PCM, with no picture (protocol 1.42).
FLAC (`.flac`): the mix, lossless, with no picture (protocol 1.43).
QuickTime (`.mov`), written fragmented like MP4 (protocol 1.51, ADR-0085).

Delivery.description:
How a recording or a stream encodes colour (protocol 1.37). Omitted when
[`Delivery::Video`], so an older file and a 1.36 client stay on Rec. 709 limited range.

oneOf.description: Rec. 709 camera encoding, limited range. YouTube, TV and streams.
sRGB transfer, full range. Matches a desktop display.

Encoding.description:
How a stream is encoded (`settings.get`, `settings.set`; protocol 1.2). The same
fields as a [`RecordingProfile`]'s encoding.

cbr_padding.description: With CBR, pad the video to its full bitrate.

encoder.description: The video encoder's adapter id, or `null` for the best one.

max_video_kbps.description: VBR peak in kbit/s; `null` is 1.5 times the target.

open_shadows.description: Lifts only the darkest tones on a Video encode. Omitted when off (protocol 1.38).

profile.description: Codec profile (`high`, `main`, `baseline`); `null` lets the encoder pick.

video_codec.description:
H.264, HEVC or AV1. Omitted when H.264, so a 1.33 client still reads the object.
`"av1"` is protocol 1.40.

video_kbps.description: Video bitrate in kbit/s: the CBR rate, or the VBR target.

oneOf.description: Refuse the start and say which files do not fit.
Start without the files that do not fit.

Encode the files that do not fit on the CPU (refused until the CPU encoder for
separate files exists, ADR-0119 step (c)).

HoldPicture.description: What a held stream sends (protocol 1.64, ADR-0124 decision 13).

oneOf.description: A scene of the collection, drawn live (protocol 1.67, ADR-0124 phase 2b).

HoldSound.description:
What a stream held with a scene sends for sound (protocol 1.67, ADR-0124 phase
2b).

oneOf.description: Silence, as a freeze or black hold.
The scene's own sources, mixed at their levels.

LoudnessSettings.description:
The loudness meter's target and true-peak limit (protocol 1.59, ADR-0092 decision
5): part of `settings.get`, `settings.set` and `settings.changed`, and of
`loudness.status`. Values are finite; equality compares them bit for bit.

target.description: The target, LUFS (-40 to -5): the mark on the Master's loudness bar.

true_peak_limit.description:
The true-peak limit, dBTP (-10 to 0): the Master's dot lights once the true
peak has passed it since the meter started or was reset.

ProjectFormat.description: An editor project format (protocol 1.58, ADR-0089 decision 9).

oneOf.description:
FCP7 XML (xmeml version 5), one `.xml` file (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro;
protocol 1.60).

RecordingMarkers.description: A recording profile's markers (protocol 1.62, ADR-0089 decisions 3 and 4).

lead_ms.description: Moves a manual marker this many milliseconds earlier, 0 to 30 000.

pause_markers.description:
One marker per pause on its join in the editor project (on by default;
protocol 1.63, ADR-0124 decision 10).

scene_changes.description: A marker each time the program scene changes (on by default).

stream_events.description: A marker when a stream starts and when it ends (off by default).

RecordingProfile.description: Every setting of a recording profile (`settings.get`, `settings.set`).

audio_tracks.description:
The buses the recording writes as audio tracks, by name, track 1 first
(protocol 1.103, ADR-0170 decisions 3 and 11). Omitted when `["main"]`. In
`settings.set`, absent keeps the stored tracks. One track for now; several
are `invalid_params` until multi-track recording is built.

bit_depth.description:
Sample width of a WAV or FLAC recording. WAV is 16, 24 or 32 (float). FLAC
is 16 or 24. Omitted when 16 (protocol 1.42; FLAC is protocol 1.43).

cbr_padding.description: With CBR, pad the video to its full bitrate.

editor_project.description:
Write an editor project next to the recording when it stops (protocol 1.58,
ADR-0089 decision 10). Omitted or `null`: off. Also what makes a plain
recording keep its files' timing for a later `project.export`.

encoder.description: The video encoder's adapter id, or `null` for the best one.

markers.description:
Markers: the reaction-time offset and the automatic markers (protocol 1.62,
ADR-0089 decisions 3 and 4). Absent: the defaults.

max_video_kbps.description: VBR peak in kbit/s; `null` is 1.5 times the target.

open_shadows.description: Lifts only the darkest tones on a Video encode. Omitted when off (protocol 1.38).

output_size.description:
Encoded picture size. Omitted or `null`: the same as this recording's canvas
(protocol 1.39, ADR-0102).

profile.description: Codec profile (`high`, `main`, `baseline`); `null` lets the encoder pick.

video_codec.description:
H.264, HEVC or AV1. Omitted when H.264, so a 1.33 client still reads the object.
`"av1"` is protocol 1.40.

video_kbps.description: Video bitrate in kbit/s: the CBR rate, or the VBR target.

ReplaySettings.description:
`settings.replay` (protocol 1.100): the replay buffer's settings. A change applies
at the next arm; a running buffer keeps its settings.

arm_on_start.description: Arm the buffer when RBS starts.

folder.description:
Where clips go, absolute; absent or `null`: the recording profile's folder. A
relative path is `invalid_params`; one that is not local needs the
irreversible-actions permission.

length_secs.description:
Wanted length of the past in seconds (`invalid_params` outside the bounds the
spec gives).

memory_mib.description: Most memory the buffer may use, in MiB.

SeparateFilesSettings.description:
`settings.separate_files` (protocol 1.100): Settings › Recording › Separate files.
Refused with `conflict` while a recording runs.

enabled.description: Record and `record.start` without `iso` write the marked sources' files.

on_hardware_limit.description:
What a `record.start` with the 1.54 parameters does with video files past
their encoder's capacity when it does not say. `cpu` is `invalid_params` in a
patch until the CPU encoder for separate files exists (ADR-0119 step (c)).

loudness.description: The loudness meter's target and true-peak limit (protocol 1.59).

replay.description: The replay buffer (protocol 1.100); absent from older servers.

separate_files.description: Separate files (protocol 1.100); absent from older servers.

stream.description:
The stream settings (protocol 1.2); absent while the app is still starting and
from servers that do not stream.

swap_after_transition.description:
Switch Preview and Program after a transition (protocol 1.100); absent from
older servers.

vertical.description:
Whether Record and Go live also act on the vertical outputs (protocol 1.42;
read only here, set with `output.set_with_vertical`).

vertical_profile.description:
The vertical recording's own settings (protocol 1.100): `null` when the
vertical recording uses the main profile; absent from older servers.

vertical_stream.description:
The vertical stream's settings (protocol 1.100): `null` when it is not set up;
absent from older servers.

StreamProtocol.description: How a stream reaches its server.

StreamSettings.description:
The stream settings (`settings.get`; protocol 1.2). The server's address is not
part of them: only the local user enters it, in the app, so an API client can neither
read it nor send the program and the stream key elsewhere. The key is never shown.

audio_bus.description:
The bus the stream sends, by name (protocol 1.103, ADR-0170 decision 3); every
destination sends it. Omitted when `main`, and `main` from older servers.

auto_record.description:
Record when the stream starts, with the recording settings; ending the stream
stops that recording (protocol 1.11; `false` from older servers).

hold_picture.description:
What `stream.hold` and Break send when they name no picture (protocol 1.65,
ADR-0124); `freeze` from older servers.

hold_scene.description:
The scene a hold with `picture: "scene"` shows when it names none (protocol
1.67, ADR-0124 phase 2b); `null` when none is set.

hold_sound.description:
The sound such a hold sends when it names none (protocol 1.67); `silence` from
older servers.

key_saved.description: A stream key is saved in the system's credential store.

output_size.description:
Encoded picture size. Omitted or `null`: the same as this stream's canvas
(protocol 1.39, ADR-0102). Not inside `encoding`.

protocol.description: The saved server's protocol, or `null` when no server is saved.

srt_latency_ms.description: SRT latency in ms; `null`: the transport's default (120 ms).

VerticalWithMain.description:
Whether Record and Go live also start and stop the vertical output (protocol 1.42,
ADR-0111 decision 4). A server older than 1.42 has none: main only.

record_with_main.description: Record also starts and stops the vertical recording.

stream_with_main.description: Go live also starts and stops the vertical stream.

VideoCodec.description: The video codec of a recording or a stream. H.264 is omitted on the wire.

oneOf.description: AV1 (protocol 1.40). A 1.39 client treats the value as unknown.

output_schema.description:
A state query's answer: the data and the `seq` of each state key it includes, so a
client ignores events with an equal or lower `seq`.
output_schema.title: Snapshot

app.description:

is_default.description: The OS default of its kind (audio endpoints).

mic.description: A camera's own microphone, when it is not a source yet (protocol 1.101).

name.description:
Name from the OS (a window title can be private: `source.targets` needs
`control`).

picker.description:
Not a target yet: adding it runs the OS picker on the computer running RBS,
so a client skips it (`target` is empty; protocol 1.101).

recent.description:
Its rank among the user's recent picks for this kind, 0 the newest
(`settings.recent_targets`; protocol 1.101).

size.description: Native size when known (displays and windows).

sound.description:
The sound that goes with a display or window can be added too (protocol
1.101).

StreamSettingsPatch.description:
The stream settings an API client may change (`settings.set`; protocol 1.2): all of
them but the server and the key. Unknown fields are ignored, so the
[`StreamSettings`] that `settings.get` returned can be sent back changed.

audio_bus.description: The bus the stream sends (protocol 1.103); absent: unchanged.

auto_record.description:
Record when the stream starts (protocol 1.11); absent: unchanged, so a 1.2
client's patch never turns it off.

hold_picture.description: What a hold sends when it names no picture (protocol 1.65); absent: unchanged.

hold_scene.description: The hold scene (protocol 1.67): absent leaves it unchanged, `null` clears it.

output_size.description:
Encoded picture size (protocol 1.39). Absent or `null` stores the same as this
stream's canvas, which clears a custom size. Not inside `encoding`.

srt_latency_ms.description: SRT latency in ms (1 or more); `null`: the transport's default.

VideoCodec.description: The video codec of a recording or a stream. H.264 is omitted on the wire.

oneOf.description: AV1 (protocol 1.40). A 1.39 client treats the value as unknown.

input_schema.description: `settings.set`: the sections given replace the current ones.

canvas.description: A new canvas; the studio restarts with it. Refused while recording.

loudness.description: The loudness meter's target and true-peak limit (protocol 1.59).

replay.description: The replay buffer (protocol 1.100); applies at the next arm.

separate_files.description: Separate files (protocol 1.100). Refused while a recording runs.

stream.description: New stream settings (protocol 1.2). Refused while a stream runs.

swap_after_transition.description: Switch Preview and Program after a transition (protocol 1.100).

vertical_profile.description:
The vertical recording's own settings (protocol 1.100): one profile, with the
`profiles` rules; `null` removes them, and the main profile applies. Refused
while a vertical recording uses them.

vertical_stream.description:
The vertical stream's settings (protocol 1.100), the `stream` patch shape: no
server and no key are written or erased. `null` is `invalid_params`. Refused
while the vertical stream runs.

The bus the stream sends, by name (protocol 1.103, ADR-0170 decision 3); every
destination sends it. Omitted when `main`, and `main` from older servers.

auto_record.description:
Record when the stream starts, with the recording settings; ending the stream
stops that recording (protocol 1.11; `false` from older servers).

hold_picture.description:
What `stream.hold` and Break send when they name no picture (protocol 1.65,
ADR-0124); `freeze` from older servers.

hold_scene.description:
The scene a hold with `picture: "scene"` shows when it names none (protocol
1.67, ADR-0124 phase 2b); `null` when none is set.

hold_sound.description:
The sound such a hold sends when it names none (protocol 1.67); `silence` from
older servers.

key_saved.description: A stream key is saved in the system's credential store.

output_size.description:
Encoded picture size. Omitted or `null`: the same as this stream's canvas
(protocol 1.39, ADR-0102). Not inside `encoding`.

protocol.description: The saved server's protocol, or `null` when no server is saved.

srt_latency_ms.description: SRT latency in ms; `null`: the transport's default (120 ms).

VerticalWithMain.description:
Whether Record and Go live also start and stop the vertical output (protocol 1.42,
ADR-0111 decision 4). A server older than 1.42 has none: main only.

record_with_main.description: Record also starts and stops the vertical recording.

stream_with_main.description: Go live also starts and stops the vertical stream.

VideoCodec.description: The video codec of a recording or a stream. H.264 is omitted on the wire.

oneOf.description: AV1 (protocol 1.40). A 1.39 client treats the value as unknown.

output_schema.description:
A state query's answer: the data and the `seq` of each state key it includes, so a
client ignores events with an equal or lower `seq`.
output_schema.title: Snapshot
